purpose: Bounded second-stage test connecting a qualified external trend to internal company data.
rules: A thematic, industry, ranking, name, or coincident-time match is not an exact join.
External and internal periods, geography, unit, and denominator must be stated separately.
Unmatched, incompatible, suppressed, and missing records must remain visible.
The bridge tests a hypothesis; it does not upgrade an external candidate into a company fact.
Rights, privacy, access, and retention limits must be recorded before data is connected.
